requirements.requirement: Keep the installed curl package at its current version so updates do not upgrade it.
requirements.summary: curl began at 0:8.12.1-4.el10.x86_64, an exact persistent versionlock was added, and a newer 0:8.12.1-6.el10 candidate was visible. Targeted upgrade attempts before and after restart reported nothing to do, leaving curl at the original version.

requirements.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The node remained on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 before and after execution and restart. The versionlock implementation was supplied by the native EL10 BaseOS package and persisted successfully.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied. curl remained at its original version despite a newer available candidate, and the lock, OS release, and kernel persisted through a fully evidenced restart. The restart protocol includes a healthy pre-state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, restored system health, and recovered task-specific state.
limitations: A complete distribution-wide update was not run; update protection was directly tested with `dnf upgrade curl`, supported by the persisted exact versionlock and visible newer candidate.
No separate application service, user-data workload, or multi-node cluster existed to validate during restart recovery; evidence covers system health and the task-specific package and lock state.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had task-related roles: installing the EL10 versionlock plugin and its transaction-required upgrades established the prerequisite; adding the lock implemented the outcome; bounded curl upgrade attempts verified it without changing curl; and the reboot exercised the required provider restart protocol. The only unnecessary retained mutation was /tmp/antrieb-reboot.log, created by the reboot command but neither used as evidence nor cleaned up. No failed services, damaged package state, or new socket exposure was observed.
